svg.title: The order for distinguishing temporary and personal files when Windows warns of low storage space
svg.desc: An English guide to the main sections of this article.

g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
The order for distinguishing temporary and personal
files when Windows warns of low storage space
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-10-31
Check the remaining space first
Before choosing what to delete, check the
current free space on the drive.
Step 1: Check temporary files first
Microsoft documents instruct you to go to
“Settings > System > Storage” and open “Cleanup
recommendations.” This list includes categories…
Step 2: Review large or unused files
If temporary files are not enough, open the
“Large or unused files” category on the same
“Cleanup recommendations” screen.
Step 3: Decide about personal files
based on their contents
Personal files such as photos, videos, and
documents may also take up a lot of space.
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
